title: Cozy 3BR Newport Home Near Town
description: Welcome to our cozy home! This 3 bedroom, 2 bath house is a great place for families and groups. The home has a full kitchen, a comfortable living room and a nice backyard. It is close to town and close to many things to do. The bedrooms are clean and comfortable with fresh linens provided. We have everything you need for a relaxing stay. The kitchen has pots, pans, dishes and a coffee maker. There is a washer and dryer for longer stays. We are happy to answer any questions you have. We hope you enjoy your stay and come back again soon. Please treat our home like your own and leave it the way you found it. Check-in is at 4pm and check-out is at 10am. No smoking and no parties please. We look forward to hosting you!
house_facts: Free parking for two cars in the driveway. Self check-in with a keypad, code sent the morning of arrival. Check-in 4pm, check-out 10am. Sleeps 6: one queen, one queen, two twins. No pets. No smoking, no parties. Wifi password is on the fridge. 5-minute walk to Easton's Beach, 10-minute walk to Bellevue Avenue. Two bikes and four beach chairs in the garage. Outdoor shower in the backyard. Coffee maker with pods. Pack-and-play available on request.
